files.description: EHI Export File Formats PDF — the sole (b)(10) documentation artifact. Single page describing XML, CSV, and PDF as export formats in generic terms. No data dictionary, no field definitions, no schema.
ONC certification landing page for Procentive. Contains EHI export description (single-patient and population export), attestation disclosure, FHIR endpoint links, and certification details.

Complete FHIR API documentation page from Dynamic Health IT's ConnectEHR platform. Contains USCDI-to-FHIR resource mapping, search parameters, example payloads, authentication setup, and Bulk Export documentation. This is (g)(10) documentation, explicitly limited to USCDI data.
FHIR server home page showing Dynamic FHIR Server 4.0.1, ConnectEHR v4 + BulkFHIR4. Lists available practice endpoints.

FHIR CapabilityStatement (metadata) for Procentive's FHIR R4 server. Lists 22 resource types including Group (with group-export operation), Patient (with patient-export operation), AllergyIntolerance, CarePlan, CareTeam, Condition, Device, DiagnosticReport, DocumentReference, Encounter, Goal, Immunization, Location, MedicationRequest, Observation, Organization, Practitioner, PractitionerRole, Provenance, Binary, ClinicalImpression, Composition.
FHIR Endpoint Bundle listing service base URLs. Contains one endpoint: https://fhir.procentive.com/fhir/procentive/basepractice/r4 for the Procentive organization.
SMART on FHIR configuration. Lists supported scopes for 26 resource types, supported capabilities including launch-ehr, launch-standalone, client-confidential-asymmetric, and permission-offline.
Full-page screenshot of the ONC certification page showing all sections: certification info, attestation disclosure, EHI Export description, FHIR endpoints, and Real World Testing link.
Viewport screenshot of the ONC certification page (above-the-fold content).
Viewport screenshot of the FHIR API documentation page showing the sidebar navigation and Getting Started section.
Rendered image of the EHI File Formats PDF page. Shows the complete content: a title, brief description, and three bullet points describing XML, CSV, and PDF formats in generic terms.
